7 gym habits worth keeping this winter
Start with the one you keep skipping.
1. Choose days you can repeat
A realistic week beats a plan you never start.
2. Pack before you need to leave
Shoes. Bottle. Headphones. One less excuse at the door.
3. Know your reps before the set
Check the plan before you pick up the dumbbells.
Keep your planned reps in Deadset
Actual Deadset app · example workout. Find Deadset on the App Store.
4. Give the set your attention
Put the scroll away until you’re finished.
5. Make room for rest
A planned day off still belongs in the week.
6. Leave a note while it’s fresh
Write down what you want to remember next time.
7. Decide when you’re coming back
Choose your next session before you leave.
